name: license_compat
description: Check whether code under open-source licences (SPDX ids: MIT, BSD, ISC, Zlib, BSL-1.0, Unlicense, CC0, Apache-2.0, MPL-2.0, EPL-2.0, CDDL-1.0, LGPL, GPL and AGPL in -only and -or-later forms) can be combined into a work under a target licence or a proprietary work. Each component gets a verdict (compatible, conditional, incompatible), the reason, the conditions to meet and its source: the FSF licence list and GPL FAQ, Apache's category A/B/X policy, the MPL 2.0 FAQ. Distinguishes copying source, static and dynamic linking where the LGPL makes it matter. Not legal advice.

target.description: SPDX id of the combined work's licence, or "proprietary"

incompatible_with_secondary.description: MPL-2.0 with the Exhibit B notice

secondary_license.description: EPL-2.0 whose Exhibit A designates GPL-2.0-or-later

linking.description: source: code copied into the work's files

catalog.source: original; FSF 'Various Licenses and Comments about Them' and GPL FAQ compatibility matrix, ASF 3rd Party License Policy (categories A/B/X), Mozilla MPL 2.0 FAQ, and the licence texts (read 18 Oct 2026)
